## About
Rob's Auto Repair is a local shop at 601 W Kings Hwy in Mt Ephraim. Neighbors bring us everything from tire work to fuel leaks, and one longtime customer trusts us with their BMW and Volvo.
Reviewers keep coming back to the same words: honest, trustworthy, reliable. One customer said they didn't feel one bit of stress getting their car repaired. Another, a mechanic himself, sends Rob the jobs he can't figure out.
We hold a 4.8 rating on Google from 62 reviews. Give us a call or stop by during the week or Saturday morning.

## Services
- New tires: Need new tires? One reviewer couldn't believe the price we quoted.
- Fuel leak repair: One reviewer came in with a fuel leak from a corroded tank. We replaced the tank and took care of a few other maintenance issues.
- Imported vehicles: A longtime customer brings us their imports, including BMW and Volvo.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on Jeeps?
A: Yes. One reviewer has been bringing their Jeeps to us and is happy with the service and costs.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, Saturday from 8:00 AM to 1:00 PM. We're closed on Sunday.

A: We're at 601 W Kings Hwy in Mt Ephraim, NJ 08059.
